name: B10-0465/2026 – Motion for a resolution
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the draft Commission regulation amending Annex III to Regulation (EC) No 1925/2006 of the European Parliament and of the Council as regards certain botanical species containing hydroxyanthracene derivatives
part_text:
The Parliament is objecting to a planned European Commission rule that would ban all food products made from certain plants (rhubarb, senna and buckthorn) that contain substances called hydroxyanthracene derivatives. Parliament says the ban goes too far, covers products the science does not clearly condemn, and should wait until the EU Court of Justice rules on related legal challenges. Parliament asks the Commission to withdraw the plan or put it on hold.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament rejects the draft ban and asks for it to be withdrawn or delayed.
- **Who it affects:** Farmers, herb growers, food businesses and consumers of these plant products.
- **What happens next:** The Commission must respond; Parliament wants a full science review and court rulings first.
